profile_text.body:
PegaSystems describes itself as a provider of an AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation. On its own site the company says organizations use Pega to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems, and that its AI is grounded in best practices with governance built in. It describes AI agents that operate with context, compliance, and human oversight, and names Pega Platform and Pega Blueprint as parts of that offering. The company says it has served large organizations since 1983.

The company is a public company traded under the ticker PEGA, with CIK 0001013857, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts.

No individual lawsuits are listed for the company. Its law exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with a count of 191. No products or MCP servers are listed for it.
